name: André M. Espinosa
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed March 2021 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 3.

biography.text: Espinosa earned a B.A. in political science and an M.P.A. from the University of Kansas and a J.D. from Rutgers Law School. He clerked for District Judge Freda L. Wolfson, New Jersey Supreme Court Justice Roberto A. Rivera-Soto, and New Jersey Appellate Division Judge Anthony J. Parrillo. He practiced at Paul Weiss and served as a federal prosecutor in San Diego, Newark, and Sacramento, including white-collar work.
